edits.original: Technical tools cannot succeed in isolation; they require clear policies, governance frameworks, and an organizational culture that prioritizes security.
edits.replacement: Technical tools require clear policies, governance frameworks, and an organizational culture that prioritizes security.
edits.reason: The negative half is windup: the positive half alone states the same claim.

edits.original: Access checks default to fail-closed, rather than open. Fail-closed is the only acceptable default for those checks, end of story.
edits.replacement: Access checks default to fail-closed, rather than open.
edits.reason: The second sentence only restates the fail-closed default already established, adding no new fact.

edits.original: Mean time to contain fell from 18 hours to 3 hours after the playbook change, which streamlines containment. The playbook change significantly reduces mean time to contain.
edits.replacement: Mean time to contain fell from 18 hours to 3 hours after the playbook change.
edits.reason: The trailing clause and following sentence merely restate the measured improvement without adding new information.

edits.original: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.reason: The clause restates that access controls deliberately limit privileges, a point the preceding sentence already makes.

edits.original: Positive reinforcement for reporters is now a standing practice, full stop.
edits.reason: This sentence restates the prior point about positive reinforcement as filler before the section moves on.

edits.original: Cybersecurity today is not merely an IT concern; it is a multidimensional discipline that underpins economic vitality, national sovereignty, and individual freedoms.
edits.replacement: Cybersecurity today is a multidimensional discipline that underpins economic vitality, national sovereignty, and individual freedoms.
edits.reason: Deleting the negated opening leaves the same claim fully stated by the positive half.
